| Past apps | row → APP-05 | count of revoked/expired |  | AdwActionRow activatable |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Open tile (active) | `→ APP-03` | Launch |
| Open tile (other status) | `→ APP-02` | Explain status |
| Context menu / long-press |  | Open · App settings (SET-02) · App profile (APP-04) · Pin · Copy app ID |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES; Empty: "No apps yet" (COPY); Offline: show cached grid read-only, launch disabled
- Resolved status per app: if any path active → Active; else precedence scheduled > disabled > expired > revoked > none (matches the API's resolved_entitlement_status). Use `GET /users/me/apps/{appId}/effective-permissions` for the authoritative answer when the user opens APP-02. Tile helper text by source of the active path: `free` → "Free"; `subscription` → "Standard" (or "Standard · via {org}"); developer grants as before. The Hub itself (`app_hub`) is hidden from the grid.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /applications (catalog the caller can see; each has access_tier free|standard)` · `GET /users/me/entitlements?include_inactive=true` · `GET /users/me (plan, plan_sources)` · `GET /organizations?status=active (for pending invites)` · `GET /users/me/notifications/unread-count (bell badge)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
